title: ein, mein, kein: nominative and accusative

content.instructions: The indefinite article (a, an) and the possessive words (my, your …) take the same endings. In the accusative only the masculine changes: ein → einen, mein → meinen. There is no plural of ein, but mein/meine and kein/keine do have one.
